en: Why do you want to buy this book?
What do you need the money for?
Why did you use up all the money?
You must consider what kind of work you want to do.
zh: 你一定要考虑清楚你想做怎么样的工作。

en: How long have you been in Japan?
How long will you stay here?
You can always count on Tom.
You're a friend of Tom's, eh?
zh: 你是汤姆的朋友，不是吗？

en: How do you get to school?
Which club do you belong to?
How high can you jump?
How tall are you?
You are very brave.
You look very tired.
That's very sweet of you.
Which bed do you want to use?
You may go anywhere you like.
zh: 你喜欢去哪儿就可以去哪儿。

en: Where do you attend high school?
Where were you?
How about you?
How did you come to know her?
Why did you say such a thing?
zh: 你为什么说了这样的事?

en: What have you come here for?
What has brought you here?
zh: 是什幺风把你吹来了啊？

en: Do you not play tennis?
You'd better go home as soon as possible.
You don't like chocolate, do you?
You have just done your homework.
You smoke far too much. You should cut back.
zh: 你吸太多烟了。你应该少抽一点。

en: You've been had.
You should give up smoking.
You should give up smoking and drinking.
All you have to do is to wait.
zh: 所有您要做的，就是等待。

en: You have only to touch the button.
You have many books.
You are very fortunate that you have such friends.
zh: 你们很幸运有这样的朋友们。

en: You may think those shoes are in fashion, but they aren't.
zh: 你可能认为那些鞋子很时髦, 但是他们不是。

en: You don't need to worry about such a thing.
zh: 你不必担心这样的事情。

en: You are old enough to know better than to act like that.
zh: 你够大了知道不要那样做。

en: You can bank on that.
Who did you give it to?
You could have done it.
Have you finished it?
Do you have one?
You will wish you had never seen it.
zh: 你会希望你从来没有看过它。

en: Did you buy it on the black market?
zh: 你是在黑市上买的它吗？

en: You should have done it earlier. It cannot be helped now.
zh: 你应该早点做的。现在没人可以帮你。

en: What did you open it with?
You shouldn't have done it.
You will not be able to catch the train.
Do you know the reason?
Could you solve the problem?
You should have introduced yourself to the girl.
zh: 你应该向那个女孩自我介绍的。

en: You must return the book to him.
You ought to know better at your age.
zh: 在你这个年纪你应该要更懂事。

en: You make too much of the event.
zh: 你对这件事太过重视了。

en: Did you watch the game?
Did you cut the paper?
You have to overcome the difficulties.
You owe me an apology for that.
zh: 关于那件事你欠我一个道歉。

en: You are responsible for the result.
Are you for or against the plan?
zh: 你赞成还是反对这个计划？

en: Are you planning to take part in the meeting?
You must get rid of that bad habit.
zh: 你必须改掉这个坯习惯。

en: Do you deny that you went there?
You should have done so.
You're wet through.
You should have told me a long time ago.
zh: 很久以前你就应该告诉我的。

en: You've got a lot of guts.
You'd better have your hair cut at once.
You'll get well soon.
You will soon get accustomed to living here.
zh: 你很快就会习惯住在这里。

en: You will soon be convinced I am right.
zh: 你很快就会相信我是对的了。

en: You will soon get accustomed to your new school.
zh: 你很快就会适应你的新学校。

en: You'd better go to see your family doctor at once.
zh: 你最好立刻去看你的家庭医生。

en: What are you staring at?
You may have mistaken Jane for his sister.
zh: 你可能误认珍为他的妹妹。

en: You must put an end to this foolish behavior.
zh: 你该结束这种愚蠢的行为了。

en: Did you do this on your own?
You have to put up with all these noises.
zh: 你必须把无视这些声音。

en: Have you read this book already?
Have you read this book yet?
You are not to leave this room.
zh: 你不应该离开这个房间。

en: You have to put up with all this noise.
zh: 你必须忍受这一切的噪音了。

en: Where did you go last Sunday?
You must get this homework finished by the day after tomorrow.
zh: 你必须在后天以前完成回家作业。

en: You can use this car.
You are suitable for the job.
Can you read this kanji?
You'll soon get accustomed to this cold weather.
zh: 你很快就会习惯这种冷天气。

en: How did you come by this money?
All you have to do is sign your name here.
zh: 你在这里签个名就行了。

en: You have only to sit here.
zh: 你要做的只是坐在这儿。

en: You can study here.
You'd better not wait here.
Are you going to sing here?
You had better get away from here at once.
You have to study hard to catch up with your class.
zh: 你必须用功读书赶上同学。

en: You must be mentally exhausted.
Not only you but also I was involved.
zh: 不止你， 连我也被牵连了。

en: Where are you from in Canada?
You should ask your father for his advice and follow it.
zh: 你应该问你父亲的忠告并遵守它。

en: You should apologize to Dad for not coming home in time for supper.
zh: 你应该为你没有及时回家吃晚餐向你父亲道歉。

en: You don't get up as early as your sister.
zh: 你没有你姐姐起得那幺早。

en: You look just like your big brother.
zh: 你和你哥哥长得一模一样。

en: Aren't you happy?
You have done very well.
You're starting to warm up now.
When did you come to Japan?
When will you be free?
When did you begin studying English?
zh: 您什幺时候开始学英语的？

en: You are always as busy as a bee.
zh: 你总是跟蜜蜂一样地忙碌。

en: You're always criticizing me!
You are always complaining.
What time do you usually get up?
What time do you usually go to bed?
zh: 你通常甚么时候上床睡觉？

en: You are always watching TV.
What on earth are you talking about?
How long have you been alienated from your family?
How much money do you want?
You have some books.
You've given me good advice.
You must be tired after such a long trip.
zh: 在这么长程的旅途后你一定很累了。

en: You shouldn't talk back to your parents like that.
zh: 你不应该对你父母那样顶嘴。

en: You shouldn't have eaten so much ice cream.
zh: 你不应该吃这么多冰淇淋。

en: Have you ever been to America?
I wish you had told me the truth then.
zh: 但愿你那时候就告诉我真相。

en: Are you on the committee?
zh: 你是委员会中的成员吗？

en: Do you know how high the television tower is?
zh: 你知道那座电视塔有多高吗？

en: You have to leave home at six.
zh: 你必须在六点钟时从家中出发。

en: You must be at the station by 5 o'clock.
zh: 五点以前你必须在车站。

en: You look the way your father did thirty years ago.
zh: 你看上去就像是三十年前你父亲的样子。

en: You must keep quiet for a few days.
You'll be able to drive a car in a few days.
zh: 几天之后你就可以开车了。

en: I would rather you had a day off.
You should have refused his offer.
zh: 你应该拒绝他的提议的。

en: You need to have breakfast.
Did you leave the window open?
You should be ashamed of your folly.
zh: 你应该为你的愚蠢感到羞耻。

en: Are you doing what you think is right?
zh: 你在做你觉得对的事吗?

en: You made the mistake on purpose, didn't you?
zh: 你故意犯这个错, 是吗?

en: You only started this job an hour ago.
zh: 你仅仅是一个小时前才开始这份工作的。

en: You may as well tell me all about it.
You must always keep your hands clean.
zh: 你应该一直让手保持干净。

en: You are always digging at me about my clothes.
When did you begin learning German?
zh: 你什么时候开始学习德文?

en: Please go on with your story.
In the light of what you told us, I think we should revise our plan.
zh: 根据你所说的话，我认为我们应该重新审视我们的计划。

en: I can hardly hear you.
Omit needless words!
Please give me your permanent address.
Your parents didn't come, did they?
I understand your position perfectly.
Is there anything you want that you don't have?
zh: 有什幺你想要但是没有的东西吗？

en: Your prophecy has come true.
I admire you for your courage.
I admire your courage.
You have lovely eyes, don't you?
zh: 你有一双可爱的眼睛，不是吗?

en: Your driver's license has expired.
zh: 你的驾驶执照已经过期了。

en: Write your name in capitals.
zh: 写下你名字的大写字母。

en: I admire your ignorance.
It won't be long before your dream comes true.
zh: 你的梦想很快就会成真了。

en: The time will come when your dream will come true.
zh: 您的梦想有朝一日会成真的。

en: Tell me about your program for the future.
zh: 给我谈谈你未来的计划。

en: What grade is your sister in?
What's your real purpose?
Your book is on the desk.
I will be your guarantor.
Please give my regards to your father.
I'm tired of your complaints.
zh: 我已经厌倦了你的投诉。

en: Your smile always makes me happy.
zh: 看见你笑，我就会高兴起来。

en: It's your move.
Your hair is too long.
Your problem is similar to mine.
Your second button is coming off.
zh: 你的第二颗钮扣快掉了。

en: Compare your answers with the teacher's.
zh: 把你的答案和老师的比较一下。

en: Compare your answer with Tom's.
Your answer isn't correct. Try again.
zh: 你的答案不对。再试试看。

en: Your answer is right.
Your answer is wrong.
I think your answer is correct.
I forget your phone number.
I forget your telephone number.
May I use your phone?
zh: 可以借你的电话用用吗？

en: Your suggestion came up at the meeting.
zh: 您的建议在会议上提过了。

en: Your proposal is a bit extreme.
I am in favor of your proposal.
How many schools are there in your city?
zh: 你们城市有多少个学校？

en: If it had not been for your advice, I would have failed.
zh: 如果没有你的忠告，我大概已经失败了吧。

en: Your idea leaves nothing to be desired.
zh: 你的想法简直无可挑剔。

en: It's none of your business.
Mind your own business!
When is your birthday?
I will give you a bicycle for your birthday.
zh: 你生日的时候，我送你一辆自行车。

en: Your son has come of age.
Your son took part in the student movement, I hear.
zh: 听说你儿子参与了学生运动。

en: I cannot accept your gift.
What's your major field?
Go back to your seat.
I can hear you, but I can't see you.
zh: 我听得见你，但我看不见你。

en: I was glad to hear of your success.
zh: 我很高兴知道你成功了。

en: Your success excites my envy.
zh: 你的成功使我感到嫉妒。

en: You have no one but yourself to blame.
Your behavior is creating a lot of problems.
zh: 你的行为引起了许多的麻烦。

en: I like the way you smile.
I expect your help.
I don't need your help.
Write your address here.
I'll miss your cooking.
I received your letter yesterday.
Your letter made me happy.
Are your hands clean?
Would you mind lending me your car?
zh: 你介意把你的车借给我吗?

en: Compared with yours, my car is small.
zh: 和你的车比起来，我的车很小。

en: May I take your picture?
I would like your picture.
Will you lend me your dictionary?
zh: 把你的字典借给我好吗？

en: Look up the words in your dictionary.
zh: 用你的词典查查这些生字吧。

en: Could you lend me your bicycle for a couple of days?
zh: 你能把你的自行车借我两天吗？

en: Your bicycle is similar to mine.
zh: 你的脚踏车和我的很相似。

en: Your bike is better than mine.
Is your watch correct?
Your watch is more expensive than mine.
Your watch is ten minutes slow.
What time is it by your watch?
Where are your things?
Just follow your heart.
I think your work is all right.
Your work is below average.
zh: 你的工作表现低于平均水平。

en: What do you do?
How is your work coming along?
zh: 你的工作进行得怎么样？

en: Your composition was good except for the spelling.
zh: 你的文章写得很好，但却有很多字拼错了。

en: Your composition is very good, and it has few mistakes.
zh: 你的作文非常好，而且错误很少。

en: There are few mistakes in your composition.
Your composition has a few mistakes.
Explain to him the difficult situation you are in.
zh: 给他讲解一下你的困境。

en: Where do you come from?
Do you eat rice in your country?
Your conduct is perfectly legal.
Your behavior leaves much to be desired.
zh: 你的行为离要求的太远了。

en: Your action has offended his dignity.
zh: 你的行为已经冒犯了他的尊严。

en: What you did brought disgrace on the whole class.
zh: 你的行为使全班的人丢脸。

en: Express your idea clearly.
Your guess is almost right.
Your view is too optimistic.
I envy you your luck.
Choose your favorite racket.
Do as you like.
Make your choice.
I am amazed at your audacity.
zh: 我对你的厚颜无耻感到惊讶。

en: I know what you mean.
What you are saying does not make sense.
I don't quite follow you.
I think you're right.
Admitting what you say, I still think you are in the wrong.
zh: 虽然我承认你说的,但是我仍然认为你是错的。

en: You may be right.
Your words must correspond with your actions.
What you say is quite wide of the mark.
All that you say is perfectly correct.
You should pay more attention to what you say.
zh: 你应该更注意你说的话。

en: I don't get what you mean.
What's become of your dog?
Your conclusion is highly arguable.
zh: 你的结论具有高度争议性。

en: You can go or stay, as you wish.
Your plan seems better than mine.
zh: 你的计划似乎比我的好。

en: I approve of your plan.
Your shoes do not go with the suit.
zh: 你的鞋子和衣服不合衬。

en: Your shoes are here. Where are mine?
zh: 你的鞋子在这儿。我的呢？

en: Your shoes are here.
I think your basic theory is wrong.
zh: 我认为你的基本理论是错的。

en: Your eyes remind me of stars.
zh: 你的眼睛让我想到了星星。

en: That is no business of yours.
Where is your school?
How many pupils are there in your school?
zh: 你的学校有多少个学生？

en: I wish I could live near your house.
Let's discuss your love problems on the way back from school.
zh: 从学校回来的路上让我们来讨论你的爱情问题。

en: Can I use your pencil?
Your English is improving.
Your English has improved a lot.
I'm amazed at your fluency in English.
zh: 你流利的英语让我很吃惊。

en: I want your opinion.
Your opinion is similar to mine.
Your opinion is very constructive.
I agree with some of your opinions.
zh: 我同意你一部分的意见。

en: I'll study your report.
Your method is different from mine.
zh: 你的方法和我的不一样。

en: You're on the right track.
Your time is up.
I'll give you anything that you want.
zh: 我会给你任何你想要的东西。

en: Can I use your pen?
Your pen is better than mine.
Your plan sounds great.
zh: 你的计划听起来很不错。

en: Your tie has come undone.
Your dress is very nice.
I'll come to your place.
I am ready to do anything for you.
I will do anything for you.
What's the weight of your suitcase?
Your shirt button is coming off.
We are worried about you.
I have absolute trust in you.
What are you fond of?
Your cake is delicious.
How many are there in your class?
Your camera is only half the size of mine.
zh: 你的照相机只有我那台的一半大小。

en: Here is your bag.
I took your umbrella by mistake.
You'll get into trouble if your girlfriend finds out the truth.
zh: 如果你女朋友发现真相的话，你会有麻烦的。

en: Your mother is in critical condition.
Your mother must have been beautiful when she was young.
zh: 你母亲年轻的时候一定很美。

en: I'd like to see your father.
Your sister looks as noble as if she were a princess.
zh: 你妹妹看上去那幺高贵，就像是个公主一样。

en: What does your aunt do?
Where does your uncle live?
I have no idea what you mean.
I believe you.
I don't agree with you.
I have something to tell you.
I have some good news for you.
I will find you a good doctor.
I want you to read this book.
I feel for you.
I refuse to be treated like a slave by you.
zh: 我拒绝被你像奴隶一样对待。

en: Your telegram arrived just as I was about to telephone you.
zh: 我正想打电话给你，你的电报就送来了。

en: You are wanted on the phone.
I'll lend it to you.
I'll make you a new suit.
zh: 我会给你做一套新衣服。

en: Who is that girl waving to you?
zh: 那个向你招手的女孩是谁？

en: I'll teach you how to drive a car.
I'll lend you my notebook.
zh: 我会借给你我的笔记本。

en: I want you to go.
I wanted to show it to you.
I'm very glad to see you.
I am looking forward to seeing you.
How I've missed you!
I want you to work harder.
zh: 我希望你更加努力地工作。

en: I want to see you again.
You have a bright future.
You have many caring friends.
zh: 你身边有很多关心你的朋友。

en: I expect you to be punctual.
I can't lie to you.
You make me feel so guilty.
You have the advantage of a good education.
zh: 你受过良好教育，这是你的优势。

en: I expect you to work harder.
zh: 我希望你更加努力地工作。

en: You are hopeless.
You deserve the prize.
Green suits you.
I can't thank you enough.
zh: 我无法表达我对你的感谢。

en: All you can do is to wait.
zh: 所有你能做的就是等待。

en: I can't keep up with you.
I have a very sore arm where you hit me.
zh: 你打在我手臂上的地方超级痛。

en: How can you say that?
You should have seen it.
Didn't I tell you so?
I'm anxious to see you.
I'll give you this pendant.
I'll give you this camera.
I'll give you this money.
Let me give you some advice.
I'll treat you.
I owe you ten dollars.
You deserve to succeed.
I can't think of life without you.
zh: 我无法想像没有你的生活。

en: I have no more time to talk with you.
zh: 我没时间再跟你说话了。

en: You and I are good friends.
You and I are the same age.
I, as well as you, was late for school yesterday.
zh: 我跟你一样昨天上学迟到了。

en: If only I could speak English as fluently as you!
zh: 如果我说英语能说得跟你一样流利的话就好了!

en: I'd like to go with you, but as it is I can't.
zh: 我很想跟你一起去, 但重点是我不能去。

en: I'd like to go to the seaside with you.
I wish I could go to the party with you.
zh: 我希望我能和你一起参加派对。

en: I would like to go to the concert with you.
zh: 我想和你一起去音乐会。

en: I would prefer to speak to you in private.
You really are hopeless.
zh: 你真的是一点希望也没有。

en: You two are the nucleus of the team.
How old will you be next year?
You had better not start until they arrive.
zh: 你最好不要在他们来之前开始。

en: You didn't need to hurry.
All of you did good work.
zh: 你们所有的人都做得很好。

en: You should try to be more polite.
You must start at once.
It is imperative for you to act at once.
Are you students at this school?
zh: 你是这所学校的学生吗？

en: You should know what to read.
Compare your sentence with the one on the blackboard.
zh: 比较一下你写的句子和黑板上的句子。

en: Who is your teacher?
I don't approve your decision.
Your team is stronger than ours.
zh: 你们的队伍比我们的强。

en: Boys, don't make any noise.
zh: 男孩们，不要制造任何噪音。

en: He as well as you likes baseball.
Not only are you wrong, but I am wrong too.
zh: 错的不只是你，我自己也错了。

en: We are both to blame.
Only you answered the question.
zh: 只有你回答了这个问题。

en: You're the only one who can do it.
You are the man I've been looking for.
zh: 你就是我一直要找的人。

en: You're the best man for the job.
zh: 你是做这份工作最好的人选。

en: I hadn't recognized the importance of this document until you told me about it.
zh: 你告诉了我以后，我才知道这份文件有多重要。

en: It's a pity that you can't come.
As long as you are here, we might as well begin.
zh: 既然你在这里, 那我们就开始吧。

en: What is it that you want?
I want you.
That you don't believe me is a great pity.
The information you gave me is of little use.
zh: 你给我的资料没有多大的用处。

en: You or I will be chosen.
If you're busy, I'll help you.
I need you.
You did well to keep the secret.
I don't know whether you like her or not.
zh: 我不知道你喜不喜欢她。

en: Does he know that you love him?
It was foolish of you to accept his offer.
zh: 你真笨去接受他的提议。

en: Whatever you said to him made him feel better.
zh: 你对他说的话让他感觉好多了。

en: I cannot approve of your going out with him.
Show me what you bought.
zh: 让我看一下你买的东西。

en: I saw you with a tall boy.
zh: 我看见你和一个个子高的男孩在一起。

en: He is no more foolish than you are.
It's a pity that you should leave Japan.
zh: 你要离开日本真是个遗憾。

en: I am going to do it whether you agree or not.
zh: 不管你同意还是不同意，我还是要做。

en: I don't object to your going out to work, but who will look after the children?
zh: 我并不反对你出去工作，可是小孩靠谁来照看呢？

en: You have good reason to be angry.
We were just talking about you when you called.
zh: 当你打电话来时, 我们正在谈论你。

en: It is a pity that you can't join us.
zh: 你不能和我们一起来真可惜。

en: You had better not wake me up when you come in.
zh: 你进来的时候最好不要把我弄醒。

en: I hope that you will get well soon.
zh: 我希望您快就会好起来。

en: I don't care whichever you choose.
I guess you are right.
Do what you think is right.
Whether you will succeed or not depends on your efforts.
